acceptance: The Question Gate contracts are closed, deterministic, bounded, and reject malformed/out-of-range policy input; policy values are explicit rather than hidden business constants.
A proposal with no blocker condition emits zero questions. Uncertainties that do not cross a blocker condition are preserved as explicit assumption ledger entries rather than silently guessed away.
When a blocker condition is met, every emitted compact question references a recorded assumption, the configured question cap is respected, and capped uncertainties remain present in the ledger.

Impact/reversibility classification is derived only from the proposal operations and existing qualified external-effect consequence semantics; confidence, impact, reversibility, and question state never become capability authority or execute an external effect.

Focused tests cover deterministic identity, policy bounds, zero-question default, high-confidence proceed-with-assumptions, low-confidence blockers, material/irreversible external-effect cases, question caps, and input immutability.

The exact candidate passes full repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline R2, Alibaba OCR deterministic/delegated review where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused Question Gate/Assumption Ledger tests plus full repository gates.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR accounting/delegated review where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: SG-000030 already supplies confidence, uncertainty, provenance, exact request/base binding, and a deterministic proposed delta. P02-S02 already supplies external-effect consequence semantics and the Product Graph assumption vocabulary. The smallest missing layer is one deterministic gate/ledger module; adding a provider router, new graph semantics, or UI would duplicate later-phase authority.

requirements: Confidence, impact, reversibility, question count, and assumption state are decision metadata only and cannot grant capability, authorization, trust, or execution authority.

Zero questions is the default. The gate may ask only about explicit recorded uncertainties that cross an explicit blocker condition; it may not invent hidden uncertainty or expand into a conversational interrogation loop.
Irreversible external-effect consequence metadata cannot be downgraded by confidence, and this Grain never executes the external effect it classifies.

outcome: A typed UserRequestProposal can be evaluated deterministically into a zero-question proceed state or a compact blocker-question state using explicit confidence, impact, and reversibility policy while every uncertainty is preserved as an inspectable assumption ledger entry and no external effect executes.
rationale: IN-P02-S03-T01 is canonically complete through SG-000027, SG-000028, and SG-000030. The roadmap now requires a deterministic Question Gate and Assumption Ledger before Product Graph user views. Existing request-proposal confidence/uncertainty/provenance plus Product Graph external-effect consequence semantics are sufficient; no provider/model routing or new graph semantics are needed.

risk.recovery: Revert the Question Gate module, exports, tests, and evidence. IN-P02-S03-T01 remains canonically complete while IN-P02-S05-T01 returns to blocked behind P02-S04.

scope_in: Define closed provider-neutral QuestionGatePolicyV1, QuestionGateDecisionV1, AssumptionLedgerEntryV1, and BlockerQuestionV1 contracts with stable deterministic identities and bounded fields.

Implement deterministic proposal-local impact and reversibility assessment from the already-qualified UserRequestProposalV1 operations, including external-effect consequence metadata, without inspecting unrelated graph state or invoking a model.

Implement an explicit confidence threshold and bounded blocker-question policy: zero questions is the default, every uncertainty is recorded as an assumption, and questions are emitted only when an uncertainty intersects a configured confidence/impact/reversibility blocker condition.
Keep blocker questions compact and deterministic by binding each question to one recorded assumption; a question cap may limit questions but must never drop the remaining assumptions from the ledger.

Add focused tests for zero-question default, high-confidence assumptions, low-confidence blockers, material/irreversible effects, question caps, deterministic identity, input immutability, and the invariant that confidence/impact/reversibility never grants capability or executes an effect.
Export only the minimal Question Gate/Assumption Ledger surface through @ineractive/product-graph with no new runtime dependency.
scope_out: No LLM/model/provider invocation, prompt routing, retrieval, CLM/Jev decision routing, tool execution, or natural-language interpretation generation; P03 owns provider intelligence.
No canonical Product Graph mutation and no automatic creation of assumption nodes/affects edges; this Grain produces a deterministic ledger/decision record only.
No UI, Product Graph user views, source/Git/database mutation, network access, credential use, capability grant, deployment, production confirmation UI, or external-effect execution.
No new Product Graph node/edge kinds or external-effect consequence vocabulary; reuse the existing P02-S02 semantics.
